method: Admission allow/deny/cache-down + cloud checks E001/E002/E005/E007/E008 + IsDesktopSession denial branches: executed against the real code offline (locmem cache, sqlite :memory: for on_commit, override_settings). Bucket/retry_after values are time-shaped (bucket=now//60, retry=60-now%60); shapes recorded with the live example. Managed checks E001..E004 recorded verbatim from source (import requires the full app registry: orchestration.agent_phases + prompting.recipes pull db models).

admission_cache_down.detail: Cloud Agent admission is temporarily unavailable

admission_semantics.check_then_consume: _take rejects on current count, consumes only on_commit so rolled-back creations burn no quota (admission.py:34-42)
admission_semantics.burst_overshoot: check-then-increment window lets concurrent bursts slightly overshoot; workspace queue cap is the hard limit (admission.py:40-42)
admission_semantics.consume_best_effort: _consume swallows cache errors with a logged exception (admission.py:26-29)

denial_body.detail: This endpoint is available to the Pi Dash desktop app.

is_desktop_session.allow_branch: authenticated + ee.authentication.desktop.request_is_desktop(request) True (EE seam, not executed here)
